verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm, a professional-services business rather than a software product, so in-product AI-generated insights from user data is the wrong axis for it. Its AI practice gives legal advice about AI, and its 'insights' are human-authored legal content. The DPDPA Compliance Assessment Tool is not shown to generate AI insights from user data, so the exception for wrong-axis capabilities does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
